goal: Allow command-line options after subcommands and positional arguments across command-line tools
Stop trailing options like -rpcwallet from being silently ignored or swallowed into positional arguments
Reject unrecognized options following commands and support using -- to end option parsing
reviewability: Reviewable now, with nothing known that would invalidate review
agreement: Approval without stated reasons after several edge cases were addressed (w0xlt)
Resolved objection: trailing options caused errors in tools like bitcoin-tx (vicjuma, w0xlt)
Resolved objection: parsing bugs with Windows slashes, lone hyphens, and early -- separators (w0xlt)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because prevents silent errors where options like -rpcwallet after a command are ignored
Avoids sending RPC requests to the wrong wallet, though deferrable

categories.name: utils
why: P2 because fixes a broad CLI flaw where trailing options are swallowed or ignored
Provides standard GNU-style option handling and error reporting across binaries for all CLI users
